description: R1 lightweight golden set for the KDS-RAG retrieval path. Each case maps a realistic member design-check scenario (the rag_context the chat tool builds from issue_type + member info) to the KDS clause(s) that should be retrieved. Used by tests/test_kds_rag_golden.py (deterministic, InMemory retriever over the real data/kds_sample corpus) and scripts/kds_rag_benchmark.py (live Voyage numbers). expected_clauses lists ALL acceptable clauses; a hit is top-k containing ANY of them (recall), and precision@1 is whether the top-1 is acceptable.
